purpose.domain_detail: IRS (Internal Revenue/Reporting System?) Nominal Ledger file/table handler within the ACAS (Applewood Computers Accounting System) package. Handles both flat COBOL files and RDBMS (DAL) access for the Nominal Ledger.
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram (file handler) for the ACAS accounting system that manages read, write, rewrite, delete, open, close, and start operations on the IRS Nominal Ledger file. It supports both traditional COBOL indexed flat files and an RDBMS Data Access Layer (DAL), dispatching based on a File-Function parameter passed via linkage section.

notable_features: Dual-mode processing: COBOL indexed files and RDBMS/DAL
COPY statements for copybooks (envdiv.cob, irswsnl.cob, wssystem.cob, wsfnctn.cob, wsnames.cob, Test-Data-Flags.cob, irsfdwsnl.cob)
Linkage Section with multiple data structures passed by caller
High GOTO count (50) for procedural dispatch pattern
Detailed error code scheme (WE-Error, FS-Reply, SQL-Err, SQL-Msg)
Logging/testing flag support via Test-Data-Flags copybook
GNU GPL licensed open-source accounting software
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 31603 bytes / 774 lines. The program is clearly production-quality with extensive changelog history (2012-2024), detailed error handling, dual flat-file/RDBMS support, and GPL licensing.
